title: Depth zero of the canonical tree when every term is killed
statement: Let $f$ be a DNF formula on $n$ Boolean variables and let $\rho$ be a restriction on those variables. If every term of $f$ is killed by $\rho$, then the canonical decision tree for $f|_\rho$ has depth $0$.
hypotheses_covered: f is a DNF formula on n variables
ρ is a restriction on n variables
every term of f is killed by ρ
replaced:
If every clause of $f$ is killed by $\rho$, the canonical decision tree for
$f|_\rho$ is the leaf $\mathrm{false}$ and hence has depth $0$.
